entries.title: Isaiah 26:1
segments: ¶In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will [God] appoint [for] walls and bulwarks.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:2
segments: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in. {truth: Heb. truths}

entries.title: Isaiah 26:3
segments: Thou wilt keep [him] in perfect peace, [whose] mind [is] stayed [on thee]: because he trusteth in thee. {perfect...: Heb. peace, peace} {mind: or, thought, or, imagination}

words.text: in thee. {perfect...: Heb. peace, peace} {mind: or, thought, or, imagination}

entries.title: Isaiah 26:4
segments: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH [is] everlasting strength: {everlasting...: Heb. the rock of ages}

entries.title: Isaiah 26:5
segments: ¶For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, [even] to the ground; he bringeth it [even] to the dust.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:6
segments: The foot shall tread it down, [even] the feet of the poor, [and] the steps of the needy.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:7
segments: The way of the just [is] uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:8
segments: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of [our] soul [is] to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:9
segments: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments [are] in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

words.text: me will I seek thee early

entries.title: Isaiah 26:10
segments: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, [yet] will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:11
segments: LORD, [when] thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: [but] they shall see, and be ashamed for [their] envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them. {at...: or, toward thy people}

entries.title: Isaiah 26:12
segments: ¶LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us. {in us: or, for us}

words.text: for us: for thou also hast wrought
in us. {in us: or, for us}

entries.title: Isaiah 26:13
segments: O LORD our God, [other] lords beside thee have had dominion over us: [but] by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

words.text: over us: [but] by thee only will we make mention

entries.title: Isaiah 26:14
segments: [They are] dead, they shall not live; [they are] deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

words.text: them, and made all their memory

entries.title: Isaiah 26:15
segments: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed [it] far [unto] all the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:16
segments: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer [when] thy chastening [was] upon them. {prayer: Heb. secret speech}

entries.title: Isaiah 26:17
segments: Like as a woman with child, [that] draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, [and] crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.

words.text: ; so have we been in thy sight

entries.title: Isaiah 26:18
segments: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:19
segments: Thy dead [men] shall live, [together with] my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew [is as] the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

entries.title: Isaiah 26:20
segments: ¶Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

words.text: thyself as it were for a little

entries.title: Isaiah 26:21
segments: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain. {blood: Heb. bloods}
